label: From wallet
description: Pay instantly from your own balance. Free, settles immediately, no external rail involved.

label: Bank transfer
description: Domestic bank transfer via your local clearing rail. Settles next business day.

label: ACH
description: US domestic transfers via ACH. Settles in 1–2 business days.

label: SEPA
description: Eurozone bank transfers. Settles same-day or next-day across the EU, EEA, and UK.

label: SWIFT
description: International bank wires via the SWIFT network. Settles in 3–5 days. Use for cross-border transfers outside SEPA.

label: Card
description: Hosted Visa / Mastercard payment page. Instant authorisation, settles T+2.

label: Crypto on-chain
description: On-chain transfer for BTC, ETH, SOL, USDC, or USDT. Settles within network confirmation windows. Irreversible.

label: Mobile money
description: Mobile-money rail (M-Pesa, MTN, Airtel). Instant settlement. Best for sub-Saharan Africa, South & SE Asia, and Latin America.
